name: research-tool
description: AI-assisted research tool with templates, scripts, and MCP servers for academic thesis/dissertation projects

scripts.validate:json: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const g=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.vscode/mcp.json','utf8')); console.log('✅ .vscode/mcp.json valid'); const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.vscode/settings.json','utf8')); console.log('✅ .vscode/settings.json valid');"
scripts.lint:py: pip install ruff -q && ruff check scripts/ --ignore E501
